annotations.text: This Software Bill-of-Materials (SBOM) document was created on Tuesday, June 9, 2026 with cdxgen. The data was captured during the build lifecycle phase. The document describes an application named 'github.com/1set/starlet'. The application also has 1 child modules/components. The package type in this SBOM is golang with 16 purl namespaces described under components. The components were identified from the source files: work/1set__starlet/cmd/starlet/go.mod, work/1set__starlet/go.mod.
